topic.name: World news & politics
topic.description: Global news and international affairs, including US foreign policy.
topic.guidance:
Consequential international developments: wars, diplomacy, cross-border trade and US foreign policy.
Exclude: Principally domestic US politics, policy, courts, elections and events.
Required phrases: 
Excluded phrases: sponsored, promo code, horoscope, gift guide

candidates.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
candidates.excerpt: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.

candidates.title: In calling for an end to the Iran War, Vance walks a thin line with Trump
candidates.excerpt: A rift is opening up between President Trump and Vice President Vance when it comes to the Iran War. NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to Susan Glasser, staff writer at the New Yorker.

candidates.title: Give Donbas, take NATO seat: Could new US pitch work for Ukraine, Russia?
candidates.excerpt: Ukraine's NATO ambition has always been a red line for the Kremlin. Giving up territory has been a no-no for Ukraine.

candidates.title: Drone attacks on power stations plunge Sudan’s cities into darkness
candidates.excerpt: Sudan's power stations are being targeted in waves of drone attacks, resulting in power outages.

candidates.title: Israel kills Hamas commander in strike on Gaza camp, officials say
candidates.excerpt: Both Hamas and IDF officials confirm the death of Samir Abu Younis, commander of the Rafah Brigade.

candidates.title: Anthony Albanese welcomes Trump-Xi-Putin summit – even as European leaders express reservations
candidates.excerpt: ‘We think dialogue is a good thing,’ Australian PM says after German chancellor urges the US to work with Europe for peace in Ukraine Australia has endorsed this week’s historic summit between Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in China, even as European leaders warn that the US president must not make major concessions over the war in Ukraine. The three-way summit is planned to take place in Shenzhen, where the leaders will gather for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) meeting. The Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, has warned the talks must not lead to a…

candidates.title: Secret votes and vetoes: How will the next UN chief be picked?
candidates.excerpt: With no frontrunner for the job, eight candidates are vying for the UN Security Council's recommendation.

candidates.title: World’s top court to rule if Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
candidates.excerpt: International court of justice has never before found a state guilty of genocide, and ruling will have implications for case against Israel The world’s top court will deliver a judgment this week on whether Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, in a landmark case that will set a critical 21st-century benchmark for the gravest of all international crimes. The closely watched judgment could become one of the most significant moments in international law since the end of the second world war.…

candidates.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts suspected Houthi missiles and drones
candidates.excerpt: Fighting escalates in Yemen's Marib and al-Jawf, as UN agency says more than 340,000 Yemenis displaced since August.

candidates.title: EU calls for immediate humanitarian access to Gaza
candidates.excerpt: The EU said that “Israel must enable the work of the UN and its agencies" after the group was blocked access into Gaza.
